scope: Main240 only; not all406, not fixed8 or long/normal/sensitivities; designed seen regression, not probabilities
matching_versions: M19 and M20 are intentionally different accounting/source/model identities; compare only report-qualified fixed physical specification/configuration/preferences/windows

method.material: Use saved classifier intervals and values; no service threshold changes
method.union: Merge saved P0/P1 e/h/c loss_runs with frozen report arithmetic epsilon 1e-8 minute; never sum carriers as clinical loss
method.longest: Maximum individual saved material run; class maxima are not sums of longest runs
method.repeated: More than one saved disjoint loss_run within one trajectory/priority/carrier or union; recurrence events=max(0,nruns-1)
method.general: Same primary segment ledger; served=requested-ENS; empty ratio for zero requested heat, not fabricated100%
method.old_material: Read old compact RESULT only after exact SHA validation; do not reconstruct missing old request/delivery
method.ENS_units: e/h/c remain separate; totals are 20 designed trajectories in each class/policy group
method.prices_or_CO2: Not evaluated by this service analysis

independent_readonly_old_material_check: Delegated independent SHA/union/carrier count verification; agreement checked by author before documentation
